` [Highlight start] Taking magnesium and alcohol together is generally safe for most adults, but alcohol depletes magnesium and makes supplements less effective [Highlight end] ` . You can read more about [how magnesium and alcohol interact](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXpr7vnzWCVbRQ62HpWEH9p6X8fLPxRjtL8i3F9QkeL32pb5EWewVjpGzp0ue7nWEvBsBTGSaSQU1pDut6yNiqKEnhZD8J7CPGyCOVyU7t5lZEUKHJqhLasy-zqyphFCjC1YsGvzNh_P2a6oTnJ8VQ4EPd7A) and potential absorption issues.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXpr7vnzWCVbRQ62HpWEH9p6X8fLPxRjtL8i3F9QkeL32pb5EWewVjpGzp0ue7nWEvBsBTGSaSQU1pDut6yNiqKEnhZD8J7CPGyCOVyU7t5lZEUKHJqhLasy-zqyphFCjC1YsGvzNh_P2a6oTnJ8VQ4EPd7A)

### How Alcohol Affects Magnesium

- **Increased urination:** Alcohol acts as a diuretic and affects kidney function, flushing magnesium out of the body through urine.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXpr7vnzWCVbRQ62HpWEH9p6X8fLPxRjtL8i3F9QkeL32pb5EWewVjpGzp0ue7nWEvBsBTGSaSQU1pDut6yNiqKEnhZD8J7CPGyCOVyU7t5lZEUKHJqhLasy-zqyphFCjC1YsGvzNh_P2a6oTnJ8VQ4EPd7A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXU6ZrT5-BpZ6YXJS0LJypGHO02lmiMOPMqR2Az3jp2Qv03TkpHZSc07Ymf-0_idT2vD8EX-1E3VsnwaZtaiTeg00VuLMn65mb90RXDoVW2aVMnUFEK73GpHRcx7ejJkp_)
- **Reduced absorption:** Digestive irritation, vomiting, diarrhea, and poor diet tied to heavy drinking can lower how much magnesium your body absorbs.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF13nJ_eImGXIeUQWtDq-ubkB08Fw-76iucAoseJWQLrBEmf3J41bT4DTTwalz_bHqmsU3_0IrXzS3NHHP26ugH_8mIak_A5-DJ8tpe9WP6Ddiyw0FCWPwcCuCMXrJxzuidi5GLzl1jUoYRTUHzYHP-HlbpJKe5FEnGM7sF9VZjIw7436vfIc3Q-NFMg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXpr7vnzWCVbRQ62HpWEH9p6X8fLPxRjtL8i3F9QkeL32pb5EWewVjpGzp0ue7nWEvBsBTGSaSQU1pDut6yNiqKEnhZD8J7CPGyCOVyU7t5lZEUKHJqhLasy-zqyphFCjC1YsGvzNh_P2a6oTnJ8VQ4EPd7A)
- **Common deficiency:** Low magnesium levels occur in about 30% to 60% of people who drink heavily or chronically.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsQEBxCJF1zGvZCrzEfFfUojy9tRrpx4uSer4UE0Lw7wK4rY5RNJHgnA5nb6YogY8Z6FRP8ROJZ-i5A8gnSQH4TXERoB2_V2gA7TS9o1BlNvEZqiEyAdG-ZHtV-TF8PuTJRDk-AUv0jwFefXTNp_OFzCKqjpMthMxKI0K3wR-bcIG8DtX52cmJH2zJ7nfXE6MsKY8GYa2XCJEg-7sNxbvEZkka6STPgdqA5j8ToJCKwiHCZE)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXpr7vnzWCVbRQ62HpWEH9p6X8fLPxRjtL8i3F9QkeL32pb5EWewVjpGzp0ue7nWEvBsBTGSaSQU1pDut6yNiqKEnhZD8J7CPGyCOVyU7t5lZEUKHJqhLasy-zqyphFCjC1YsGvzNh_P2a6oTnJ8VQ4EPd7A)

### Risks and Side Effects

- **Supplement side effects:** Combining magnesium supplements with alcohol—especially at high doses—can increase digestive side effects like nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXpr7vnzWCVbRQ62HpWEH9p6X8fLPxRjtL8i3F9QkeL32pb5EWewVjpGzp0ue7nWEvBsBTGSaSQU1pDut6yNiqKEnhZD8J7CPGyCOVyU7t5lZEUKHJqhLasy-zqyphFCjC1YsGvzNh_P2a6oTnJ8VQ4EPd7A)
- **Low magnesium symptoms:** Depleted levels can contribute to muscle cramps, weakness, fatigue, tremors, irritability, irregular heart rhythms, or low potassium and calcium.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXpr7vnzWCVbRQ62HpWEH9p6X8fLPxRjtL8i3F9QkeL32pb5EWewVjpGzp0ue7nWEvBsBTGSaSQU1pDut6yNiqKEnhZD8J7CPGyCOVyU7t5lZEUKHJqhLasy-zqyphFCjC1YsGvzNh_P2a6oTnJ8VQ4EPd7A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsQEBxCJF1zGvZCrzEfFfUojy9tRrpx4uSer4UE0Lw7wK4rY5RNJHgnA5nb6YogY8Z6FRP8ROJZ-i5A8gnSQH4TXERoB2_V2gA7TS9o1BlNvEZqiEyAdG-ZHtV-TF8PuTJRDk-AUv0jwFefXTNp_OFzCKqjpMthMxKI0K3wR-bcIG8DtX52cmJH2zJ7nfXE6MsKY8GYa2XCJEg-7sNxbvEZkka6STPgdqA5j8ToJCKwiHCZE)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF13nJ_eImGXIeUQWtDq-ubkB08Fw-76iucAoseJWQLrBEmf3J41bT4DTTwalz_bHqmsU3_0IrXzS3NHHP26ugH_8mIak_A5-DJ8tpe9WP6Ddiyw0FCWPwcCuCMXrJxzuidi5GLzl1jUoYRTUHzYHP-HlbpJKe5FEnGM7sF9VZjIw7436vfIc3Q-NFMg)
- **Withdrawal complications:** Low magnesium can worsen central nervous system excitability and withdrawal symptoms.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqgEBxCJF18gtBa5n3FzUtc90xX7gy6UlpX1iuyTrQ0rNJs705PNTGZZEkVb3xwN-6A3f1unartQL63hAOmVPnD94t-oKZtcAQNLGwNB0g4whBWIBQojRR7sj69iJNL6O58lWwnguaUK2uHxY2HUBakQgGavkpw0zXUwmOFAr0gGKSNZZWnAPNrrTTSdu8qhU50M83mFhqauMNokTRHh1IYYqHWWgBySq9FWhBg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsQEBxCJF1zGvZCrzEfFfUojy9tRrpx4uSer4UE0Lw7wK4rY5RNJHgnA5nb6YogY8Z6FRP8ROJZ-i5A8gnSQH4TXERoB2_V2gA7TS9o1BlNvEZqiEyAdG-ZHtV-TF8PuTJRDk-AUv0jwFefXTNp_OFzCKqjpMthMxKI0K3wR-bcIG8DtX52cmJH2zJ7nfXE6MsKY8GYa2XCJEg-7sNxbvEZkka6STPgdqA5j8ToJCKwiHCZE)

### Practical Takeaways

- **Space them out:** Taking magnesium separately from alcohol and limiting alcohol intake supports better absorption.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXX-31tKrkNtutaEqTOQOKkZSz0PMgRLESL0ury8JF9GqPcu0SkhwAj33IjOOQCSYhFZcU72HrGU0QldRJzbeNBQ3BUSSrsqRD_ifbTAoP6w8bdXgY52YdqSroopFh10ZX9i5JsH0gObZhVyfooK9Zs4IGtvDez1GJGABA)
- **Don't rely on it as a fix:** Magnesium will not prevent or reverse alcohol-related organ damage while drinking continues.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXpr7vnzWCVbRQ62HpWEH9p6X8fLPxRjtL8i3F9QkeL32pb5EWewVjpGzp0ue7nWEvBsBTGSaSQU1pDut6yNiqKEnhZD8J7CPGyCOVyU7t5lZEUKHJqhLasy-zqyphFCjC1YsGvzNh_P2a6oTnJ8VQ4EPd7A)
- **Check with a clinician:** Ask a doctor or pharmacist before using magnesium supplements to address a deficiency, manage withdrawal, or pair with medications.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXpr7vnzWCVbRQ62HpWEH9p6X8fLPxRjtL8i3F9QkeL32pb5EWewVjpGzp0ue7nWEvBsBTGSaSQU1pDut6yNiqKEnhZD8J7CPGyCOVyU7t5lZEUKHJqhLasy-zqyphFCjC1YsGvzNh_P2a6oTnJ8VQ4EPd7A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsQEBxCJF1zGvZCrzEfFfUojy9tRrpx4uSer4UE0Lw7wK4rY5RNJHgnA5nb6YogY8Z6FRP8ROJZ-i5A8gnSQH4TXERoB2_V2gA7TS9o1BlNvEZqiEyAdG-ZHtV-TF8PuTJRDk-AUv0jwFefXTNp_OFzCKqjpMthMxKI0K3wR-bcIG8DtX52cmJH2zJ7nfXE6MsKY8GYa2XCJEg-7sNxbvEZkka6STPgdqA5j8ToJCKwiHCZE)
